prompt: Wide editorial portrait for a fine-jewelry campaign. A Mexican woman in her late twenties with warm tan skin, natural dark brown wavy hair loosely tucked behind one ear, minimal makeup, genuine soft smile, positioned on the right third of the frame, looking slightly down.
